# Source: Chocolate-Menier Pavilion, World's Columbian Exposition, Chicago, Illinois, Perspective View

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Chocolate-Menier Pavilion, World's Columbian Exposition, Chicago, Illinois, Perspective View
- **Artist / culture:** Peter Joseph Weber (American, 1863-1923) C. Graham (American)
- **Date:** 1893
- **Style:** 19th century
- **Classification:** design drawing
- **Department:** Architecture and Design
- **AIC artwork ID:** 143172
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/143172
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/16fe7626-81fa-33b6-5144-5bda478ef148/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Architecture

## Extracted source palette

`#C8D8C8, #A8C8C8, #B8B898, #98A898, #989878, #88B8B8, #788878, #787858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#4F4F3E`
- `surface`: `#555549`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#C8D8C8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#787858`
- `surface_variant`: `#636354`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#7E7E72`
- `error`: `#C8D8C8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `inter` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `2dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `7.84:1`, surface `7.1:1`
- Variant contrast: `5.74:1`
- Control contrast: `13.13:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
